reason: I'm curious about letting an agent handle rebalancing, but a cartoon pet running my real money feels like a toy, and there's no named broker and no price yet. I already trade fine on Robinhood for free, so I'm not signing up for a paid plan I can't size up.
objection: A Tamagotchi feels unserious for money. I'd want to know which licensed broker actually holds my account and what it costs before I hand an AI any say over real dollars.
would_change_my_mind: Naming the licensed broker partner with SIPC protection and a clear monthly price, plus a few months of the demo agent's track record I could check against just holding the index fund myself.
